title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: Public companies double share of blockchain revenue since 2022: Report
description: A new 1kx report finds that public companies are capturing a larger share of blockchain revenue, driven by institutional adoption and real-world applications.

title: Chrome Can Now Pull Details From Your Gmail to Fill Out Web Forms
description: Chrome's new autofill uses Google's Gemini AI to search your Gmail for order numbers, tracking details, and flight bookings and fill them into web forms. It is rolling out in the U.S.

title: Polymarket suspended trading amid reports of user funds being drained
description: The prediction markets platform halted trading on Thursday after it reported one of its third party providers had been compromised.

title: Polymarket suspends trading after third-party breach leads to user losses
description: Polymarket said one of its third-party providers was breached after users reported seeing their accounts drained.

title: Polymarket Pauses Trading as Prediction Market Investigates Security Incident
description: Polymarket restricted trading and paused relayer actions as users report funds leaving their accounts. A suspected attacker wallet holds about $2.65 million in POL, per Arkham data.

title: Hackers Publish Work Details of 41,000 Homeland Security Employees
description: A hacktivist group says it took names, titles, and phone numbers of 41,000-plus DHS staff from a login system.

title: Crypto Spends $176 Million on Midterms, But Only 13% of Voters See It as a Priority
description: Only 13% of Americans say a candidate’s support for crypto growth is very important, according to a survey conducted by Ipsos for the DeFi Education Fund, even as the industry spends heavily on next week’s elections.

title: $11 Billion in Bitcoin Options Expire Tomorrow—Here's What It Means
description: A third of Deribit's Bitcoin options settle Friday, a day after the Fed held rates with two officials voting to hike. Here's why that matters for Bitcoin's price.

title: HYPE teases all-time high as NYSE owner ICE eyes US Hyperliquid perps
description: Hyperliquid’s token pumped following news of ICE and Trade[XYZ] unveiling plans for US perpetual futures.

title: KuCoin suspends services in Russia and Belarus
description: The exchange cited legal and regulatory compliance in its reason for cutting off services to users based in the two countries, currently the targets of international sanctions.

title: Stanley Druckenmiller's first X post backs Hyperliquid venture after $23 million indirect investment
description: The billionaire investor disclosed an investment in Trade[XYZ] as the platform teams up with the NYSE's parent company. His family office previously reported owning shares in a HYPE-focused treasury company.

title: KuCoin exits Russia and Belarus as crypto exchanges withdraw from Western-sanctioned markets
description: The exchange is closing accounts in both countries after MEXC and Bitget announced similar moves earlier this month.

title: From rivals to partners: Polygon and Solana team to bring stablecoin payments to banks
description: The two networks are setting aside their rivalry to connect Solana's stablecoin activity with Polygon's banking, wallet and payment infrastructure.

title: 4M Bitcoin Bought Above $85K Could Cap Recovery: Glassnode
description: Bitcoin is trading close to the average price paid by U.S. spot ETF holders, a day after the Federal Reserve held rates steady.

title: Nasdaq-listed Canton Strategic Holdings plans tokenized stock trading from Nov. 2
description: The tokenized shares would carry the same shareholder rights as traditional stock, with round-the-clock trading and immediate settlement under the SEC’s innovation exemption.

title: Crypto exchange HTX exits the UK after settling with the FCA
description: The former Huobi exchange has stopped accepting deposits from British customers and agreed not to target them with crypto promotions.

title: Hyperliquid's HYPE Jumps 13% as NYSE Owner ICE Moves to Bring Its Perpetual Futures to the US
description: Intercontinental Exchange signed a deal with Trade[XYZ] to launch regulated perpetual futures built on Hyperliquid in the United States, sending HYPE soaring.

title: Kalshi raises $1B at $40B valuation as non-sports revenue run rate tops $1B
description: The funding round comes as Kalshi expands its partnerships with the NBA and S&P Dow Jones Indices while facing legal challenges over its sports contracts.

title: Bitcoin price jumps to $81.5K as US GDP data beats expectations
description: BTC price action returned to a key weekly resistance level as US stock markets digested Alphabet’s Q3 earnings miss.

title: Walmart Blocks Its Stock From OKX-ICE Tokenized Trading Venue
description: Walmart, Eli Lilly, Cigna, Carniva,l and Arcos Dorados objected to trading of their shares on the planned OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue, bringing the total to 38.

title: French Senate adopts bill for automatic sharing of crypto tax data
description: The French Senate adopted a bill authorizing the automatic exchange of crypto-asset tax information between international tax authorities, pending completion of the legislative process.

title: Polymarket brings ultra-short crypto prediction markets to U.S. platform
description: Polymarket’s new Up/Down crypto contracts come as the CFTC renews scrutiny of the prediction market’s compliance with its 2022 U.S. onboarding terms.

title: Crypto for Advisors: Only 1 in 5 Americans say the financial system is secure
Bank of England opens consultation on tokenized collateral for clearing
description: Central counterparties would need to show tokenized collateral meets liquidity and risk tests under proposed Bank of England guidance.

title: Why Switzerland’s first genuine spot bitcoin ETF could soon attract overseas banks and brokers
description: SIX Swiss Exchange confirms international access, while FINMA explains why it approved the fund and whether ether and solana ETFs could follow.

title: Chainlink adds weekend pricing for tokenized assets, with Aave as launch partner
description: The service uses perpetual futures quotes to update reference prices when traditional markets close.

title: Canton Foundation grants RedStone 15.8M Canton Coin for pricing standard
description: RedStone’s planned pricing tool will let institutions on Canton use shared market prices without exposing deal terms to data providers.

title: New quantum model slashes hardware needed to break bitcoin keys by 17 times
description: Alice & Bob's new model reduces the hardware required for a potential attack, bringing it closer to reality and increasing pressure to adopt quantum-resistant security sooner.

title: Walmart, Eli Lilly join growing pushback against OKX–ICE tokenized stock plans
description: Five more companies have objected, bringing the total to 38 as a rival Canton venue prepares to launch with an issuer-sponsored stock under the SEC's innovation exemption.

title: Brazil’s Halloween eve crypto deadline brings more tricks than treats
description: Brazil’s crypto exchanges face an application deadline on Friday, with costly requirements and unanswered regulatory questions complicating compliance.

title: Private, fast USDT is coming to Bitcoin. Can it compete with Ethereum and Tron?
description: USDT is coming home to Bitcoin, offering privacy and Lightning-fast payments. But can Bitcoin’s revamped version of Tether compete with stablecoins on ETH and TRON?

title: Polygon Extends Its Stablecoin Payments Infrastructure to Solana
description: The expansion gives Solana businesses one integration to connect bank funding, embedded wallets, cross-chain transfers and global payouts, with cross-border firm Kira among the first adopters.

title: Polygon expands Open Money Stack to Solana, after Tron rollout
description: The move follows the addition of Tron support and Polygon’s acquisition of Coinme.

title: Justin Sun's HTX Agrees to Leave UK in Settlement With Financial Watchdog
description: The FCA says the Justin Sun-linked exchange will no longer target UK consumers, ending its first case against a crypto firm over marketing.

title: A new framework for tokenized asset tracking
description: None of the numbers most commonly used to assess tokenized assets answer the question a chief investment officer would ask about those assets on her own balance sheet: what is it doing for me?

title: Tokenized stock venue on Canton could beat OKX–ICE to first trade under SEC framework
description: The venue, called TSV LLC, plans to start trading shares Canton Strategic Holdings shares as early as Monday, using issuer-sponsored tokenization that avoids the 30-day company objection window.

title: Chainalysis traces North Korean crypto cash-outs through Garantex
description: The analysis followed US sanctions against 10 people and one entity accused of helping North Korean IT worker schemes fund weapons programs.

title: Morning Minute: Hedge Funds Left the BTC ETF Trade and Sovereign Wealth Stepped In
description: Now the BTC ETFs have flipped green for the month after $400M+ inflows this week, setting the stage for a big November.

title: Unlimit founder backs Phase blockchain with $45M as mainnet launches
description: Phase’s new network lets smartphone owners earn tokens for validating transactions and sharing internet connections with AI agents.

title: HTX agrees to halt unlawful UK crypto promotions after FCA case
description: HTX has pledged to stop crypto marketing in the UK until October 2031, with deposits and new account registrations already blocked there.

title: U.S. sanctions Russian nationals for laundering millions in crypto for North Korean IT workers
description: Russian nationals Ilya Boykov and Vitold Obertas allegedly converted about $3.5 million and nearly $2 million in crypto, respectively, for North Korea.

title: As $10 billion in bitcoin options near expiry, the tell is in the pricing
description: Your day-ahead look for Oct. 29, 2026

title: EU investors rank crypto above retirement plans for lasting wealth creation: OKX survey
description: European investors ranked crypto above retirement plans for lasting wealth creation, while prior surveys show US investors are skeptical on crypto’s role in retirement accounts.

title: Coinbase seeks Brazil crypto license, expects no service disruption
description: Coinbase has applied for authorization ahead of Brazil’s Oct. 30 deadline and says it expects to maintain existing services while regulators review its application.

title: Bitcoin lending and yield could drive next wave of institutional demand, Rootstock says
description: A new report argues that putting institutional Bitcoin holdings to work through lending, collateral and financing could create demand beyond its store-of-value role.

title: Treasury Sanctions 11 Over North Korean IT Worker Scheme That Moved Millions in Crypto
description: Two Russian nationals converted more than $5 million in crypto for North Korean networks, according to OFAC, which listed their wallets.

title: Bitcoin drops to $80,000 on Fed dissent, Samsung, Alphabet earnings; AI tokens slump
description: Bitcoin fell 1.4% since midnight UTC to around $80,100 as disappointing reports from Samsung and Alphabet weighed on tech stocks. The Fed’s preferred inflation gauge is due later today.

title: NYSE owner takes steps to bring Hyperliquid perpetual futures to U.S.
description: The planned ICE[XYZ] venue would offer 24/7 perpetual futures on stocks, commodities and crypto, pending CFTC approval. ICE is investing in Trade[XYZ].

title: Utah Files Felony Charges Against Kalshi, Co-Founders Over Sports Bets
description: The state says an undercover agent placed a dozen sports wagers on Kalshi, a day after the CFTC sued Utah to block its enforcement actions.

title: Cathie Wood’s ARK buys the dip on Robinhood in its largest purchase in 6 months after 23% slump
description: HOOD fell 3.3% on Wednesday, broadening its one-month decline to more than 23%.

title: Bitcoin long-term resistance in focus as analysis sees selling risk above $85K
description: BTC price analysis from Glassnode drew attention to $85,000 as the lower boundary of a cost-basis zone for long-term holders.

title: Solana wallet Solflare pledges to pay missed rewards on staked $160 million after validator goes offline
description: About 1.56 million SOL sat on a validator that stopped earning, and the wallet still hasn’t named the firm that held its keys.

title: Live updates: Bitcoin gives up gains as Nasdaq slides to session low
description: Strategy's STRC has hit its highest price since May, and the company could soon be ready to restart large bitcoin purchases.

title: ECB President Christine Lagarde to step down in February 2027
description: Lagarde announced plans to step down as European Central Bank President after serving more than seven years in the role.

title: Thai Supreme Court rules bitcoin is property after thief challenges conviction
description: The court said bitcoin has a market price, can be cashed out and held by the public. It upheld a 10-year sentence for a man who helped the robbers.

title: Bermuda taps WalletConnect to advance its onchain economy plan
description: Bermuda chose WalletConnect to bring crypto payments to local merchants, starting with ticketing platform PTIX in the second quarter of 2027.

title: Former Swift CEO joins stablecoin firm OpenTrade as chairman
description: Lazaro Campos takes the board role as the London-based company reports $300 million in assets locked and more than $1 billion in annual transaction volume.

title: The chart bitcoin traders should be paying attention to
description: A market at an inflection point could shape inflation trends and the prices of risk assets, from bitcoin to tech stocks.

title: Bitcoin ETFs add $137M, pushing October back into the green
description: Bitcoin ETFs drew $424 million over three days, lifting October net inflows to $111 million despite a hawkish Federal Reserve decision and weaker crypto sentiment.
